signals.thesis: Healthcare sector leader surging +5.2% with massive bullish call flow (20,921 contracts at $400 strike, 5.4x average). Healthcare Plans industry +5% today — best-performing sub-sector. EMA20 > EMA50 > EMA200 momentum structure intact. RSI 66.9 — strong without overextension. VIX 15.74 supports risk-on healthcare positioning.

Financials sector +2% with banks leading. Active BUY signal since May 28 — +8.7% return since trigger. Just printed 52-week high at $1,095.90. GS benefits from M&A advisory surge and elevated FICC revenues. Forward PE 16.7x is attractive for bulge bracket returns. Correlation with portfolio = 0.10 (UNH) to 0.56 (ABNB) — well diversified.

Industrials sector +2% with Caterpillar leading the infrastructure capex cycle. Active BUY signal since May 20 — +7.8% since trigger. Hit 52-week high $946.83 today. CHIPS Act + IRA spending wave drives multi-year equipment demand. CAT's pricing power sustains margins despite commodity input costs. 200DMA distance 46.3% — elevated but reflects secular trend, not parabolic move.

Biotech sector +4% today. NBIX approaching 52-week high ($169.57) at $167.35 — within 1.3% of breakout. Active BUY signal since May 29 with +6.2% follow-through. Forward PE 13.2x is cheap for a commercial-stage neuro franchise (INGREZZA for tardive dyskinesia). Biotech industry average return +4% today — sector tailwind is real.

Aerospace & Defense industry +5% today — top-performing sub-sector. RTX surged +3.98% yesterday. Defense spending tailwind from NATO commitments and US supplemental appropriations. Pratt & Whitney aftermarket revenues provide secular growth beyond geopolitical catalysts. RTX sits 2.5% below 50DMA — room to run before any overextension concern. Negative correlation with NBIX (-0.17) adds portfolio diversification.

Fresh BUY signal triggered June 4 at $43.21 — recovery play from the $35 March lows. GLP-1 market leader (Ozempic/Wegovy) with 12-month forward PE 13.3x — historically cheap. Stock is 5.5% above 50DMA and 10.4% below 200DMA — classic pullback recovery structure. Healthcare sector +3% provides sector tailwind. 4.1% dividend yield adds income cushion.

stressScenarios.description: Fed rate hike +100bps: equities fall via ERP compression, bonds reprice
Equity market crash -20%: beta-adjusted drawdown across all positions
VIX spike to 40: volatility repricing, equity decline proportional to vol exposure
Crypto crash: BTC -30%, altcoins down more, minimal equity impact
Geopolitical crisis: risk-off flight to safety, equity decline, gold/USD rally
